scope: bounded static V3.8 analysis; no physical-device operation

clear.behavior: Loads [r0+0x10], clears bit r1, stores it back.

set.behavior: Loads [r0+0x10], sets bit r1, stores it back.

measurement_fsm_state1.send_path: Loads descriptor pointer and byte[4], calls 0x80005e84, then 0x80061f84.
measurement_fsm_state1.limits: Command-ID measurement meanings, exact pin/port identity, and electrical effect are not yet proven.

correction: 0x800031b8 is a PIO bit-clear helper, not a scheduler/callback dispatcher; it is not evidence of an FSM +0x30 consumer.
